verdict.rationale: Merchant catalog publishing is a fair question for an agentic-commerce platform like Crossmint, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no feed or import API for merchants to publish products into agent surfaces. Agent Checkouts work buyer-side from a product URL the agent supplies, and the llms.txt probe covers Crossmint's own docs rather than a merchant catalog, so neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can publish my product or service catalog into agent surfaces through a documented feed or import API so AI agents can discover what I sell
